title: Fasting hyperglycemia and absent exercise angina fail to improve cross-hospital angiographic CAD prediction
abstract: Adding fbs*(1-exang) to flexible additive conventional measures worsened external Brier score by 0.002541; baseline-minus-augmented gain -0.002541, paired source-refit/target bootstrap 95% interval [-0.012622,0.006915]. No predictive benefit is established. Hungarian development:285 patients/104 cases;Cleveland external evaluation:303/139. Source5foldCV also worsened. Only20 source patients had fbs>120mg/dL; sparse strata and institutional missingness undermine mechanistic interpretation. Historical cohort reuse prevents untouched confirmation. This is a negative representation test,not evidence against diabetic silent ischemia or proof of equivalence. AI-authored and author-self-checked,not independently peer reviewed.
